findings.text: follow-on: the unit-table coverage is bounded by `assert checked > 0` while the two continues at :357/:360 silently skip any bound rule whose source channel is absent from the E101154 cache, so the test can pass while most bindings are never checked; the loop and probe channels are separately guaranteed present by the pin tests, but Ip and the pf_active/tf channels are not, so a wrong table entry for those would go unseen.

follow-on: the blocked-reason guard triggers on the literal substring "E101154 alone", so a future reason that rests a choice on E101154 without the word "alone" (for example "rests on E101154") while citing a corroborating shot would not be caught, which is the exact self-contradiction the guard exists to stop.
